entries.title: The bank moved its signed-in landing screen
entries.evidence_regex: signed-in screen not recognized|unknown screen after sign-in|never reached the console
entries.vision_prompt: Does the screenshot show a signed-in console (banner, navigation, a member search), not a sign-in form, a blank shell or a code page? If so, the driver's signed-in screen signature no longer matches.
entries.action: Update the profile's signed-in screen signature from what the screen shows, and prove it on a fresh and a trusted-workstation sign-in.

entries.title: A code page with a 'Send code' control that must be pressed first
entries.vision_prompt: Is there a code input and a separate 'Send code' or 'Request code' control visible together? If so, no code is sent until that control is pressed.
entries.action: Press the send control once, wait for the bank's proof that a code was sent, then open a human task for the code.

entries.title: A notice or consent overlay covers the sign-in form
entries.vision_prompt: Is a banner or modal covering the sign-in fields or the submit control? It intercepts clicks and typing.
entries.action: Recognize the overlay as its own screen and dismiss it with its non-committal choice before touching the form.

entries.title: The sign-in control stays disabled because a required script never loaded
entries.vision_prompt: Are the fields filled but the submit control still greyed out, with nothing visible left to complete? A script the form depends on may have failed to load.
entries.action: Check the network events for a failed script from another origin; report it as the bank's fault with evidence, rather than retrying the form.

entries.title: A signed-in state was claimed without proof on the screen
entries.vision_prompt: Is a signed-in console actually visible in the latest screenshot? Cite the region that proves it. A matching address, a status code or the agent's own claim is not proof.
entries.action: Prove sign-in by recognizing a signed-in screen; never by the absence of a password field.

entries.title: Text was typed into a field that is not visible
entries.vision_prompt: Was every field that received typing visible on the screenshot at the time? A hidden duplicate swallows the keystrokes and leaves the visible form empty.
entries.action: Target only visible, topmost controls from the screen model; if the real field appears after a reveal, perform that click first.

entries.title: An action reached past an encapsulated part of the page
entries.vision_prompt: Was any action taken against something that is not a visibly drawn control? Name the action and the step.
entries.action: Act only on controls in the screen model, by their names and positions; never reach into encapsulated content.
